targets.y_value: simulated mean 2-hour glucose in mg/dL over logged meals
targets.day_index: day in the patient log, four meals per day, in the same order as the foods
targets.glucose_2h: simulated 2-hour glucose in mg/dL after each food, in time order
targets.glucose_delta: glucose_2h minus that patient's fasting glucose, the simulated effect of that food
targets.energy_kcal: kcal for the eaten serving, 4 kcal/g carbohydrate and protein and 9 kcal/g fat
targets.carbohydrate_g_100g: carbohydrate per 100 g, from the serving and portion weight
targets.sodium_mg: simulator estimate of sodium in the eaten serving
targets.calcium_mg: simulator estimate of calcium in the eaten serving
targets.iron_mg: simulator estimate of iron in the eaten serving
targets.vitc_mg: simulator estimate of vitamin C in the eaten serving
